"""Changelog and version files from Conventional Commit messages. See task.md."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pathlib
import re


class CommitError(ValueError):
    """Raised when `previous_version` is not a valid `X.Y.Z` version."""


_VERSION = re.compile(r"(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)")
_HEADER = re.compile(r"([a-z]+)(?:\(([^()]*)\))?(!)?:(.*)")
_BREAKING_TOKENS = ("BREAKING CHANGE:", "BREAKING-CHANGE:")
_SECTIONS = ("Breaking changes", "Features", "Fixes", "Performance")


def _parse(message: str):
    subject, _, body = message.partition("\n\n")
    subject = subject.strip()
    if len(subject.splitlines()) != 1:
        return None
    match = _HEADER.fullmatch(subject)
    if match is None:
        return None
    kind, scope, bang, description = match.groups()
    description = description.strip()
    if not description:
        return None
    scope = (scope or "").strip() or None
    breaking = bang is not None or any(
        line.strip().startswith(_BREAKING_TOKENS) for line in body.splitlines()
    )
    return kind, scope, description, breaking


def _entry_lines(pairs):
    seen = set()
    lines = []
    for scope, description in sorted(
        pairs, key=lambda pair: (pair[0] is None, pair[0] or "", pair[1])
    ):
        line = f"- **{scope}**: {description}" if scope else f"- {description}"
        if line not in seen:
            seen.add(line)
            lines.append(line)
    return lines


def build(commits: list[str], previous_version: str, out_dir: str) -> None:
    """Write `<out_dir>/CHANGELOG.md` and `<out_dir>/version.txt`."""
    if _VERSION.fullmatch(previous_version) is None:
        raise CommitError(f"invalid version: {previous_version!r}")
    major, minor, patch = (int(part) for part in previous_version.split("."))

    parsed = [p for p in map(_parse, commits) if p is not None]
    breaking = [(s, d) for k, s, d, b in parsed if b]
    features = [(s, d) for k, s, d, b in parsed if k == "feat" and not b]
    fixes = [(s, d) for k, s, d, b in parsed if k == "fix" and not b]
    performance = [(s, d) for k, s, d, b in parsed if k == "perf" and not b]

    if breaking:
        major, minor, patch = major + 1, 0, 0
    elif features:
        minor, patch = minor + 1, 0
    elif fixes or performance:
        patch += 1
    version = f"{major}.{minor}.{patch}"

    sections = dict(zip(_SECTIONS, (breaking, features, fixes, performance)))
    changelog = [f"## {version}\n"]
    for title in _SECTIONS:
        lines = _entry_lines(set(sections[title]))
        if lines:
            changelog.append(f"\n### {title}\n\n")
            changelog.extend(f"{line}\n" for line in lines)

    directory = pathlib.Path(out_dir)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (directory / "CHANGELOG.md").write_bytes("".join(changelog).encode("utf-8"))
    (directory / "version.txt").write_bytes(f"{version}\n".encode("utf-8"))
